name: G&A Partners
summary: G&A Partners is an IRS-certified PEO that enters a co-employment relationship with its clients. It gives them access to medical, dental, vision and retirement plans and handles payroll and payroll taxes. It publishes a typical range of $65 to $150 per employee per month for core HR functions, with employer-paid benefits billed separately.

facts.text: G&A says an IRS-certified PEO (CPEO) takes on greater liability and is solely responsible for handling payroll taxes.
G&A says compliance responsibility is shared between the PEO and the business, and the business remains responsible for complying with employment laws.
G&A organizes its services for companies with 0 to 10, 11 to 99 and 100 or more employees and states no minimum headcount.

plans.name: PEO core HR functions
plans.notes: G&A states a typical range of $65 to $150 per month per employee for core HR functions. This is a range, not a list price, and a quote sets the actual fee

hiddenCosts: Employer-paid benefits are often billed separately from the PEO fee.
A one-time implementation fee may apply.
